same_source_resume.within_unspent_limits: Scientifically compatible in principle with identical compiled source, entire config, case and validated checkpoint, after the old process has exited and any restart is explicitly authorized; preserve cumulative resource use and raw crash tails.
same_source_resume.after_reached_limit: NOT_EXECUTABLE_AS_IS. run() checks the entire config bytes and compiled_identity (axbi_driver.rs:1309-1317); checkpoint restores accepted,tentative,RHS and solver wall (895-940); the run loop immediately stops again when those cumulative quantities reach their unchanged cap (1372-1381).
same_source_resume.resource_only_config_override: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_EXISTING_BINARY. Editing the command config alone raises AXBI_RESUME_IDENTITY. Editing the saved config/source record to defeat that comparison would erase the original binding and is not an authorized continuation.
same_source_resume.launcher: run_campaign.py explicitly has no resume/retry surface, freezes max_steps/max_attempts/max_rhs/max_wall_s in validate(), and stops dispatching queued cases after a failed case. Invoking its existing --run again is not a continuation.
same_source_resume.external_kill_detail: Outer timeout is10799s while driver wall cap is10800s. An external cap stop can leave only the latest durable checkpoint and no terminal RETURN. Before any continuation, account actual launcher/CPU consumption and discarded attempted tail in addition to the checkpoint counters; checkpoint wall is not an exact total external charge.

smallest_next_execution_decision.if_resource_cap: Preserve terminal or durable checkpoint, source/config, complete accepted output prefix, first stop and external resource evidence. smallest_next_execution_decision.minimal_mechanical_preparation: If a cap is reached and continuation is allocated, lower-tier worker implements only a supported resource-only continuation path. smallest_next_execution_decision.not_released_here: No new resource amount, threshold, command invocation, source edit or solver job is released by this read-only decision.

numerical_algorithm_adaptation.reason: Resource pressure alone does not invalidate the integration. The inspected local estimator and deterministic selection are operating within their frozen contract; no measured full-cap stop or evidence of defective step control was supplied.
numerical_algorithm_adaptation.when_to_reconsider: If the actual stopped state plus one explicitly bounded compatible continuation shows inadequate useful progress, or a concrete numerical defect is observed, authority may freeze one targeted numerical-method repair with an overlap comparison. Do not quietly alter error weights, accepted solution, physical source, closure, grid or tolerance.
numerical_algorithm_adaptation.new_method_identity: A solver/controller change creates new numerical-method evidence. It cannot be called exact same-source continuation. Preserved old histories remain valid at their original conditional scope; a new method needs independent changed-surface review and appropriate numerical overlap/refinement before admission. Full refined histories still start from their explicit zbar20 IC per the full campaign contract.

independent_review.resource_only_changed_path: One fresh read-only reviewer checks the exact continuation diff, original identity preservation, unchanged scientific evolution, cumulative caps/accounting, append/reconcile behavior, and a targeted resume equivalence/control test before executing the newly bound continuation.
independent_review.full_history_admission: Actual completed histories still need independent numerical/physical data review and the staged component refinements relevant to each claimed contrast. A resource-continuation review is not C11,AX15 or whole-goal PASS.
independent_review.stopping_rule: One targeted resource repair and its focused regression/review; PASS opens the explicitly allocated continuation immediately. If incompatible, return the exact incompatibility without expanding generic audit machinery.

comparison_interpolation_convention.authority_scope: Parent explicitly requested this convention during the read-only resource decision; no evolution model or numerical tolerance changed.
comparison_interpolation_convention.grid: Exactly1001 samples indexed j=0..1000: L_j=ln(1/21)+(j/1000)*ln(21/5). Use a=1/21 atj0 and a=1/5 atj1000 explicitly; zbar=1/a-1. No substitute grid uniform in zbar,proper time or Tgas.
comparison_interpolation_convention.interpolation: For each case and scalar observable independently, piecewise linear interpolation in L=ln(a) between its consecutive time-ordered accepted rows. Evaluate exact native sample matches directly. Interpolate candidate/reference proper time independently on that same L grid and retain both.
comparison_interpolation_convention.validity: No extrapolation; no sorting by Tgas or other observable; no bridging missing or invalid accepted rows. A full-history comparison requires coverage of every1001 sample in every necessary case. Partial-overlap output is allowed only with an explicit PARTIAL_INTERVAL label and omitted samples reported, never zero-filled.
comparison_interpolation_convention.milestones: For each thresholdxHII=0.1,0.5,0.9 find the first chronological upward bracket x_i<threshold<=x_(i+1). Set theta=(threshold-x_i)/(x_(i+1)-x_i); L_cross=(1-theta)*L_i+theta*L_(i+1); t_cross=(1-theta)*t_i+theta*t_(i+1); reconstruct zbar_cross=exp(-L_cross)-1. If the initial accepted row is exactly the threshold, report the initial endpoint explicitly rather than divide by a flat segment. Record all later distinct upward crossings; avoid duplicate reporting of an endpoint crossing shared by neighboring segments.
comparison_interpolation_convention.not_reached: No upward bracket gives null with NOT_REACHED and actual covered interval. Being above a threshold already at the initial row does not supply an earlier crossing.
comparison_interpolation_convention.reported_differences: Retain the specified full-grid supremum absolute differences, endpoint differences, successive resolution differences and milestone shifts separately. These are sampled/interpolated diagnostics, not continuous-domain suprema.
comparison_interpolation_convention.interpolation_uncertainty: UNKNOWN unless separately estimated from actual accepted samples using a justified procedure. Linear interpolation is a deterministic comparison convention, not evidence its error is negligible. Do not absorb unknown interpolation error into evolution error, assign it zero, or claim a total numerical accuracy PASS from unresolved interpolation uncertainty.
comparison_interpolation_convention.execution_transition: Provider may implement this exact comparator convention within its already assigned paths and preparation budget. This permits comparator preparation, not an additional scientific history or full-history admission.
